testcase.name: test Timeline.list_runs/2 returns ALL runs (fresh + replay) for a record, chronologically, scoped to tenant
test Records.list_records/2 outcome filter an unknown outcome value is ignored (filter dropped), not passed to SQL
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) the disposition subquery is tenant-scoped — a foreign run never leaks in
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) a record with no fresh run projects nil outcome + nil mailbox
test Records.list_records/2 suppression flag projection (IOPS-05) the list select surfaces each record's suppression_flagged column
test Detail.fetch/2 blank tenant returns nil
test Records.list_records/2 search filter (WR-03) matches against the envelope recipient
test Records.list_providers/2 blank tenant returns []
test Records.list_records/2 tenant safety nil tenant returns []
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) projects the LATEST fresh run when a record has several
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) a same-time tie chooses the fresh run with the greatest id
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) a :no_match record projects a nil mailbox (reads as 'no match')
test Detail.fetch/2 returns nil for a record that belongs to a different tenant (gate before replay)
test Records.list_providers/2 returns distinct providers for one tenant within the window
test Records.list_records/2 search filter (WR-03) stays tenant-scoped — a matching foreign row is invisible
test Records.list_records/2 search filter (WR-03) narrows results by a case-insensitive subject substring
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) ignores a replay run, projecting only the latest FRESH disposition
test Records.list_records/2 search filter (WR-03) treats LIKE wildcards as literals (no widening)
test Timeline.list_runs/2 blank tenant returns []
test Timeline.list_runs/2 returns [] when a scoped record has no execution history
test Records.list_records/2 search filter (WR-03) matches against the provider message id
test Records.list_records/2 suppression flag projection (IOPS-05) a record left at the column default reads suppression_flagged: false
test Records.list_records/2 tenant safety returns ONLY the queried tenant's rows
test Records.list_records/2 tenant safety does not leak another tenant's row even with a matching provider filter
test Records.list_records/2 tenant safety missing tenant returns []
test Records.list_records/2 disposition projection (WR-01) a matched record projects its latest-fresh-run outcome + mailbox
test Records.list_records/2 tenant safety blank tenant returns []
test Timeline.list_runs/2 preserves exact source, outcome, ID and times with same-time ID ordering
